cells.callsite_parameters: interval=20, tau=10; AFLink thrT=(0,30) thrS=75 thrP=0.05
cells.notes: GSInterpolation = LinearInterpolation(interval) then GaussianSmooth(tau). GaussianSmooth rebuilds every row of every track from GPR predictions, so it rewrites pre-existing detection rows, not only inserted ones. Execution order in strong_sort.py: AFLink (line 35) then GSI (line 46). AFLink re-associates tracklets and can therefore change track IDs. Deterministic: RBF length scale is 'fixed', no restarts.
